name: 2002 Golden Lotus livery
description: Deep blue fuselage over a pale belly, the two parted by a gold line that dips into the nose, runs along the lower side and sweeps down to the belly behind the wing, the tail cone blue all round. Blue fin with a large gold lotus; 'Vietnam Airlines' in light gold lettering over the forward windows with a small gold lotus ahead of it; blue engines.

logos.description: The Golden Lotus: a gold lotus of five long pointed petals fanning upwards from a small ring at the base (the outer pair curling out), drawn as gold shapes with blue gaps, standing on the fin's root and leaning back with its sweep.
The lotus small and upright just forward of the title, on both sides.
A small Vietnamese flag near the fin tip, by the leading edge.
The small SkyTeam member mark (swirl in a circle, 'SKYTEAM' below) in pale gray behind the cockpit windows.

titles.style: Light, upright sans in mixed case, gold, above the forward windows behind the small lotus.

notes: Gold line measured on the A350 VN-A898 (right, 2025) and checked on the A321neo VN-A512 (left, 2025); on the A321 it sits a little higher amidships. The belly color is a pale warm gray-white in most photos (low sun makes it cream). The 787s carry the same scheme. Registration and aircraft type are small white lettering aft, per airframe. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on VN-A898 (A350-900, near side-on; drawnOn A359, where the gold line was measured): the title runs x 0.176 to 0.372 with its baseline just above the windows (y 0.3) and capitals about 0.33 tall (it had been drawn starting on the window line); the small lotus ahead of it centred x 0.155. On the A321neo VN-A512 the title runs about x 0.19 to 0.38. The gold line and the belly's edge are curves: smooth.
history: Replaced Skyarium v1's approximation. Introduced with the Golden Lotus identity in 2002 (replacing the 1990s stork scheme), lightly refreshed with the 2015 rebrand; still current.
